name: Battle of the Sexes
summary: Two-player coordination game where each prefers a different coordinated outcome but both prefer coordination to miscoordination.
rules_text: Two players choose simultaneously between two options, for example Boxing and Opera. Player 1 prefers Opera, Player 2 prefers Boxing. If both choose Boxing, payoffs are 1 to Player 1 and 2 to Player 2. If both choose Opera, payoffs are 2 to Player 1 and 1 to Player 2. If they choose different options, both get 0. Each player picks one option without seeing the other's pick. Payoffs are then awarded from the matrix. There are two pure Nash equilibria at the two coordinated outcomes, and a mixed equilibrium where each randomizes.
rating_reason: Battle of Sexes is classic 2x2 simultaneous game, fully engine-expressable.
